register.description: Reset control for Command FIFO and flush control for MAU Core. This register is not self-clearing.

bitfield.description: Set to zero on Write, ignore on Read.

pkeFlush input to PKE[active high]. When set, this bit will assert the mauFlush input to MAU Core, resets command FIFO, issues reset to MCG. Flush sequence will complete some cycles after this bit is cleared. PKE will remain in flush state as long as this bit is asserted
Set to zero on Write, ignore on Read.

register.description: Interrupt Status Register. Writing a 1 to any bit in this register clears the associated interrupt.Cleared on pkeFlush.

bitfield.description: Set to zero on Write, ignore on Read.

Asserted when SRAM initialization [when enabled] or FLUSH sequence after reset are completed. The PKE core will go into IDLE state when SRAM initialization [when enabled] and FLUSH sequence after resset finish.
Asserted when MCG status indicates ERROR/PANIC. This interrupt is re-asserted when cleared if MCG status is MCG_ERROR/PANIC in PKE_STATUS register
Set to zero on Write, ignore on Read.
This interrupt is re-asserted when cleared if MAU Core Status is ERROR/PANIC in PKE_STATUS register.

This interrupt is asserted when FIFO transitions to empty. fifoEmpty gets asserted when pkeFlush is issued to the core triggering this interrupt. To disable interrupt just after pkeFlush, user can mask the corresponding bit in PKE_IFC_ICR register
This interrupt is re-asserted when cleared if FIFO Write Error is asserted in PKE_STATUS register.
This interrupt is asserted when MAU status transition from BUSY to READY/ERROR/PANIC.
Interrupt is generated on transition to idle [FIFO Empty and ![mauState==BUSY] & ![mcgState==BUSY]]

register.description: Interrupt Control Register. Writing a 1 to any bit in this register enables the associated interrupt.

bitfield.description: Set to zero on Write, ignore on Read
Writing a 1 to any bit enables ram init and flush on reset to idle interrupt
Writing a 1 to any bit enables MCG Error interrupt
Set to zero on Write, ignore on Read.
Writing a 1 to any bit enables MAU state is error panic interrupt
Writing a 1 to any bit enables transition to FIFO empty interrupt
Writing a 1 to any bit enables FIFO Error interrupt
Writing a 1 to any bit enables MAU command done interrupt
Writing a 1 to any bit enables transition to idle interrupt

register.description: Reports the status of the Command FIFO, Mau Core, and Mau Command Generator.

bitfield.description: Reflects the status of compare result when compare command is completed by MAU core only when the MAU command is issued by AHB. Will be cleared on pkeFlush.
Set to zero on Write, ignore on Read.
MCG currently does not advertise error cause. Will be cleared on pkeFlush.
This reflects the command generator unit status. Cleared when MCG Status is error and pkeFlush is issued. 0x0: MCG_IDLE 0x1: MCG_BUSY 0x4: MCG_ERROR 0x8: MCG_PANIC
MAU Core Status State 0x0 : MAU_READY 0x1: MAU_BUSY 0x2: MAU_ERROR 0x8: MAU_PANIC Cleared when MAU Core Status is error and pkeFlush is issued.
This reflects the command FIFO status. Cleared on pkeFlush. 0b0000 FIFO_EMPTY 0b0001 FIFO_NOT_EMPTY 0b0011 FIFO_FULL 0b01xx FIFO_ERROR

register.description: Register to (re)seed PRNG.

bitfield.description: When written all 128 bits in this register will reseed PRNG inside PKE. The reseed happens when register at 0x5C is written. So, it is important to write 0x50, 0x54, 0x58 before Writing 0x5C. Reseed completes in one cycle, so no status is returned. The register value at 0x50 forms the lowest word of 128 bits and register at 0x5C forms the highest word of 128 bits seed. Reseed vale is {pkePrngSeed[0x5C], pkePrngSeed[0x58], pkePrngSeed[0x54], pkePrngSeed[0x50]
